description: This file defines the 'browser' class, which manages various server-side actions for a web-based file browser, including directory navigation, file uploads, thumbnail management, and ZIP compression of files/directories, within the KCFinder project.

classes.name: browser
classes.description: Class providing server-side handling for a web-based file manager, including directory operations, file manipulation, thumbnail management, and ZIP downloads within the KCFinder project.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Entry point to invoke the appropriate action method based on user request, managing permissions and response headers.

methods.name: act_browser
methods.description: Handles directory navigation actions, updating session directory state based on user input.

methods.name: act_init
methods.description: Initializes directory tree and file list, returning structured data for client display.

methods.name: act_thumb
methods.description: Serves thumbnail images for files, generating default or actual thumbnails as needed.

methods.name: act_expand
methods.description: Returns subdirectory information for tree expansion.

methods.name: act_chDir
methods.description: Changes current directory context based on user selection.

methods.name: act_newDir
methods.description: Creates a new directory within the current directory.

methods.name: act_renameDir
methods.description: Renames an existing directory.

methods.name: act_deleteDir
methods.description: Deletes a directory and its thumbnails.

methods.name: act_upload
methods.description: Handles file upload to current directory, including permission checks and thumbnail creation.

methods.name: act_download
methods.description: Streams selected file to client for download.

methods.name: act_rename
methods.description: Renames a file, along with associated thumbnail.

methods.name: act_delete
methods.description: Deletes a file and its thumbnail.

methods.name: act_cp_cbd
methods.description: Copies multiple files within the same directory.

methods.name: act_mv_cbd
methods.description: Moves multiple files to current directory.

methods.name: act_rm_cbd
methods.description: Removes multiple files.

methods.name: act_downloadDir
methods.description: Creates and serves a ZIP archive of a directory.

methods.name: act_downloadSelected
methods.description: Creates and serves a ZIP archive of selected files.

methods.name: act_downloadClipboard
methods.description: Creates and serves a ZIP archive of files in clipboard.

methods.name: sendDefaultThumb
methods.description: Serves a default icon image for files without thumbnails.

methods.name: getFiles
methods.description: Retrieves list of files in a given directory, including icons and metadata.

methods.name: xmlTree
methods.description: Converts directory and file info into XML format for client-side rendering.

methods.name: getTree
methods.description: Recursively builds directory tree structure.

methods.name: postDir
methods.description: Returns the current directory path based on POST data, validating existence.

methods.name: getDir
methods.description: Returns the current directory path based on GET data.

methods.name: getDirs
methods.description: Lists subdirectories within a directory.

methods.name: getDirInfo
methods.description: Gathers metadata about a directory, such as readability, writability, and subdirectory presence.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Renders data via template or default method for client.

methods.name: errorMsg
methods.description: Handles error reporting, outputting messages in appropriate format and context.
